summary: Rezones 15.30 acres at 4107 and 4186 Dodson Chapel Road and an unnumbered Dodson Chapel Road parcel, at the southwest corner of Old Hickory Boulevard, from RS15 and SP to SP zoning. It allows accessory uses to mineral extraction, with later uses limited to CL zoning uses in District 1 and RS15 uses in District 2 once extraction stops.
